== Patch 1.3.5d ==

* 🐱 🐶 The Pawesome Festival is enabled!,
** You'll find Worldgates in all major cities to go and celebrate animals in Windscour!
** A Daily Quest will spawn at 02:00, 14:00 and 19:00 SERVER TIME
* ⏰ The Divine Blessings Clock is enabled again! You'll be granted 3x [Divine Blessings Coin], up to 4 times a day. You can spend these on Mirage Isle.
* 👻 ⛵ The value of [Delphinad Ghost Ship Stone Slab] has been increased to 100 gold
* 🥒 The cost of [Mahadevi Pickles] has been adjusted. The Resident Only recipe was not priced correctly.
* 💃 The Yata Dance is now back to being functional. Sorry for the delay on this!
* 🦑 🐲 The Tuesday and Thursday timer for bosses (RD, Kraken) have been adjusted from 9 AM ST to 7 AM ST to better match players on the target timezones
